The generated catch event (X1) is the correct modeling choice. The guideline is therefore mainly a clarification of EVT-03 for the case where the time-window end precedes the conclusion or a foll)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names several activities that must all be finished before a later activity can start, and it states no decision or order among them: Model the named activities as parallel branches opened by a parallel gateway, and join them with a parallel gateway before the later activity. Use an exclusive gateway only when the description states a choice between the activities.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names several activities in one sentence, performed by the same actor or in the same phase, with no stated order between them, and a later activity or the end of the process starts only after all of them are done

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a follow-up activity or the conclusion of the process happens only after a stated time window or deadline has ended: Model the moment the time window ends as an intermediate catch event placed directly before the follow-up activity or the end event. Do not model the waiting itself as a task, and do not let an activity stand for the passing of time.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a follow-up activity or the conclusion of the process happens only after a stated time window or deadline has ended

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says the process ends only after a period of time elapses or a condition becomes true, following earlier activities: Model the waiting for the period to elapse or the condition to become true as an intermediate catch event (timer or conditional) placed before the end event on the sequence path. Do not model the wait as a task, because a task performs work and does not wait for an external time or condition.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says the process ends only after a period of time elapses or a condition becomes true, following earlier activities

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names several activities that must all be finished before the process moves on or ends, and it gives no order among them: Model a parallel gateway that splits into those activities as concurrent branches, and a second parallel gateway that joins the branches before the next element or the end event. Do not chain the activities in a fixed sequence, and do not join them with an exclusive gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that one activity runs over a stretch of time while another activity proceeds alongside it, with no order stated between them, and a later activity starts only after both have finished

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity as a verb and object, followed by a purpose, scope or qualifying clause in the same sentence: Name the task with the verb and object of the stated activity, using the description's own words, and leave the purpose or scope clause out of the task label. Do not append words from that clause, and do not add a qualifier the description does not attach to the activity itself.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity as a verb and object, followed by a purpose, scope or qualifying clause in the same sentence
